name: Ursula
source:
The owner of the tavern "White Wolf of Darkness" (無明の白狼亭) which is the most popular in Ishgalia amongst adventurers. She rents out rooms, sells food and gives out quests to adventurers. She has a formidable intelligence network and often assists Orias when he is looking for information.

[Spoiler] Orias after a great amount of expense and difficulty finds out Ursula is a member of the local thieves' guild and has direct access to some members of the ruling council of Ishgalia. Because of the influence she wields, Demetrio Madram is unable to attack the tavern directly to silence Meriel permanently. Five years prior to Orias' arrival in Ishgalia, she had a physical relationship with a young adventurer Yohane which ended with his premature death during a quest. His death depressed her for five years and each year she travels to a hidden graveyard in secret to tend to a makeshift grave she erected on Yohane's behalf. [/Spoiler]
